questions.text: cos⁻¹ x की मुख्य शाखा है :
questions.text_english: The principal branch of cos⁻¹ x is :
questions.solution: The principal branch of cos⁻¹ x is [0, π]. By convention, the principal value branch of cos⁻¹ is chosen as [0, π] because cosine is monotonically decreasing on this interval, making it one-one and onto onto [-1, 1]. Option A ([π/2, 3π/2]) and options B and D represent non-standard branches not used as the principal branch.
questions.solution_hindi: cos⁻¹ x की मुख्य शाखा [0, π] है। परिपाटी के अनुसार cos⁻¹ की मुख्य मान शाखा [0, π] ली जाती है क्योंकि इस अंतराल पर कोज्या एकदिष्ट ह्रासमान होती है, जिससे यह [-1, 1] पर एकैकी तथा आच्छादक होती है।

questions.text: λ के वे मान जिनके लिए f(x) = sin x − cos x − λx + C, x के सभी वास्तविक मानों के लिए हासमान है, हैं :
questions.text_english: The values of λ so that f(x) = sin x − cos x − λx + C decreases for all real values of x are :
questions.solution: For f(x) to decrease for all real x, we need f'(x) ≤ 0 for all x. Here f'(x) = cos x + sin x − λ. The maximum value of cos x + sin x is √2 (achieved at x = π/4). For f'(x) ≤ 0 for all x, we need λ ≥ maximum value of (cos x + sin x), i.e., λ ≥ √2. Hence option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: f(x) सभी वास्तविक x के लिए हासमान होने के लिए f'(x) ≤ 0 होना चाहिए। f'(x) = cos x + sin x − λ। cos x + sin x का अधिकतम मान √2 है। अतः λ ≥ √2 होना चाहिए।

questions.text: यदि A तथा B समान कोटि के वर्ग आव्यूह हैं तथा AB = A तथा BA = B है, तो A² + B² बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If A and B are square matrices of same order such that AB = A and BA = B, then A² + B² is equal to :
questions.solution: Given AB = A and BA = B. Then A² = A·A = (AB)·A = A(BA) = AB = A. Similarly B² = B·B = (BA)·B = B(AB) = BA = B. Therefore A² + B² = A + B. Option A is correct. Options C and D are incorrect because there is no factor of 2 or the expression 2BA.
questions.solution_hindi: दिया है AB = A तथा BA = B। तो A² = A·A = (AB)·A = A(BA) = AB = A। इसी प्रकार B² = B। अतः A² + B² = A + B।

questions.text: यदि f(x) = (1 − sin³x)/(3cos²x), x ≠ π/2 के लिए; k, x = π/2 के लिए; x = π/2 पर संतत है, तो k का मान है :
questions.text_english: If f(x) = (1 − sin³x)/(3cos²x) for x ≠ π/2; k for x = π/2; is continuous at x = π/2, then the value of k is :
questions.solution: For continuity at x = π/2, k = lim(x→π/2) (1 − sin³x)/(3cos²x). Let x = π/2 − h as h→0: numerator becomes 1 − cos³h ≈ 3h²/2 and denominator becomes 3sin²h ≈ 3h². So the limit = (3h²/2)/(3h²) = 1/2. Therefore k = 1/2. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: x = π/2 पर संततता के लिए k = lim(x→π/2) (1 − sin³x)/(3cos²x) = 1/2। अतः k = 1/2।

questions.text_english: For real x, let f(x) = x³ + 5x + 1. Then :

options.A: f, R पर एकैकी है लेकिन आच्छादक नहीं है
options.B: f, R पर आच्छादक है लेकिन एकैकी नहीं है
options.C: f, R पर एकैकी और आच्छादक है
options.D: f, R पर न तो एकैकी है और न ही आच्छादक

options_english.A: f is one-one but not onto on R
options_english.B: f is onto on R but not one-one
options_english.C: f is one-one and onto on R
options_english.D: f is neither one-one nor onto on R

questions.solution: f'(x) = 3x² + 5 > 0 for all real x, so f is strictly increasing everywhere, making it one-one (injective). Since f is a continuous strictly increasing function with f(x)→−∞ as x→−∞ and f(x)→+∞ as x→+∞, by the Intermediate Value Theorem, f takes every real value, so f is onto (surjective). Therefore f is a bijection. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: f'(x) = 3x² + 5 > 0 सभी वास्तविक x के लिए, अतः f सख्त वर्धमान है जो इसे एकैकी बनाता है। f सतत और सख्त वर्धमान है तथा R पर सभी मान लेती है, अतः यह आच्छादक भी है।

questions.text: यदि एक रेखा के दिक्-कोसाइन λ, λ, λ हैं, तो λ बराबर है :
questions.text_english: If the direction cosines of a line are λ, λ, λ, then λ is equal to :
questions.solution: The sum of squares of direction cosines equals 1: λ² + λ² + λ² = 1, so 3λ² = 1, giving λ² = 1/3 and λ = ±1/√3. Both positive and negative values are valid since direction cosines can be positive or negative. Therefore option D (±1/√3) is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: दिक्-कोसाइनों के वर्गों का योग 1 होता है: λ² + λ² + λ² = 1, अतः 3λ² = 1, λ = ±1/√3।

questions.text: यदि |−1 2 4; 1 x 1; 0 3 3x| = −57 है, तो x के सम्भव मानों का गुणनफल है :
questions.text_english: If the determinant with rows (−1, 2, 4), (1, x, 1), (0, 3, 3x) equals −57, the product of the possible values of x is :
questions.solution: Expanding the determinant: −1(3x² − 3) − 2(3x − 0) + 4(3 − 0) = −3x² + 3 − 6x + 12 = −3x² − 6x + 15. Setting this equal to −57: −3x² − 6x + 15 = −57, so −3x² − 6x + 72 = 0, giving x² + 2x − 24 = 0. Factoring: (x + 6)(x − 4) = 0, so x = −6 or x = 4. Product of possible values = (−6)(4) = −24. Option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: सारणिक प्रसार करने पर −3x² − 6x + 15 = −57 मिलता है। सरल करने पर x² + 2x − 24 = 0, अतः (x + 6)(x − 4) = 0, x = −6 या x = 4। गुणनफल = −24।

questions.text_english: The matrix with rows (0, 1, −2), (−1, 0, −7), (2, 7, 0) is a :
questions.solution: For a skew symmetric matrix, aᵢⱼ = −aⱼᵢ and all diagonal elements are zero. Here a₁₁ = a₂₂ = a₃₃ = 0. Also a₁₂ = 1 = −(−1) = −a₂₁; a₁₃ = −2 = −2 = −a₃₁; a₂₃ = −7 = −7 = −a₃₂. All conditions satisfy the skew symmetric property. Hence the matrix is skew symmetric. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: विषम सममित आव्यूह में aᵢⱼ = −aⱼᵢ तथा सभी विकर्ण अवयव शून्य होते हैं। दिए गए आव्यूह में यह सभी शर्तें संतुष्ट होती हैं।

questions.text_english: If f(x) = {3x − 2, 0 < x ≤ 1; 2x² + ax, 1 < x < 2} is continuous for x ∈ (0, 2), then a is equal to :
questions.solution: For continuity at x = 1, left-hand limit must equal right-hand limit. LHL = lim(x→1⁻)(3x − 2) = 3(1) − 2 = 1. RHL = lim(x→1⁺)(2x² + ax) = 2(1)² + a(1) = 2 + a. Setting LHL = RHL: 1 = 2 + a, so a = −1. Therefore option D is correct.

questions.solution: The median from A to midpoint M of BC is given by AM = (AB + AC)/2 = ((0,1,1) + (3,−1,4))/2 = (3, 0, 5)/2. The length |AM| = √(9 + 0 + 25)/2 = √34/2. Option C is correct.

questions.text: ∫eˣ(cos x − sin x) dx बराबर है :
questions.text_english: ∫eˣ(cos x − sin x) dx is equal to :
questions.solution: Using the standard formula ∫eˣ[f(x) + f'(x)]dx = eˣf(x) + C: here if f(x) = cos x, then f'(x) = −sin x. So eˣ(cos x − sin x) = eˣ[f(x) + f'(x)]. Therefore ∫eˣ(cos x − sin x)dx = eˣ cos x + C. Option D is correct. The other options do not match this result.

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण dy/dx + y tan x − sec x = 0 का समाकलन गुणक है :
questions.text_english: The integrating factor of the differential equation dy/dx + y tan x − sec x = 0 is :
questions.solution: The equation is dy/dx + y tan x = sec x, which is of the form dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x) where P(x) = tan x. The integrating factor is e^(∫P dx) = e^(∫tan x dx) = e^(log|sec x|) = sec x. Option B is correct.

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) के सुसंगत क्षेत्र के कोनीय बिंदु (0, 2), (3, 0), (6, 0), (6, 8) तथा (0, 5) हैं। यदि उद्देश्य फलन Z = ax + by; (a, b > 0) का अधिकतम मान (0, 2) तथा (3, 0) पर प्राप्त होता है, तो a तथा b में संबंध है :
questions.text_english: The corner points of the feasible region of a Linear Programming Problem are (0, 2), (3, 0), (6, 0), (6, 8) and (0, 5). If Z = ax + by; (a, b > 0) be the objective function, and maximum value of Z is obtained at (0, 2) and (3, 0), then the relation between a and b is :
questions.solution: Since Z is maximum at both (0, 2) and (3, 0), the objective function value must be equal at these two points. Z at (0, 2) = 2b and Z at (3, 0) = 3a. Setting 2b = 3a gives 3a = 2b. Therefore option D is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: (0, 2) पर Z = 2b तथा (3, 0) पर Z = 3a। दोनों बिंदुओं पर Z का मान समान होने से 2b = 3a, अर्थात 3a = 2b।

questions.text: ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) is :
questions.solution: ∫ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) = ∫ eˣ dx/(e²ˣ + 1). Let t = eˣ, dt = eˣ dx. Then integral = ∫ dt/(t² + 1) = tan⁻¹(t) = tan⁻¹(eˣ). Evaluating from 0 to 1: [tan⁻¹(eˣ)]₀¹ = tan⁻¹(e) − tan⁻¹(1) = tan⁻¹ e − π/4. Option C is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: ∫₀¹ dx/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ) = [tan⁻¹(eˣ)]₀¹ = tan⁻¹ e − tan⁻¹(1) = tan⁻¹ e − π/4।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : यदि A तथा B दो ऐसी घटनाएँ हैं कि P(A ∩ B) = 0 है, तो A तथा B स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं।
तर्क (R) : दो घटनाएँ स्वतंत्र होती हैं यदि एक के घटने का दूसरे के घटने पर कोई प्रभाव न पड़े।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): If A and B are two events such that P(A ∩ B) = 0, then A and B are independent events.
Reason (R): Two events are independent if the occurrence of one does not effect the occurrence of the other.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही उत्तर चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled Assertion (A) and the other labelled Reason (R). Select the correct answer from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The Assertion (A) is false. P(A ∩ B) = 0 means A and B are mutually exclusive (not independent). For independence, the required condition is P(A ∩ B) = P(A)·P(B), which is not necessarily satisfied when P(A ∩ B) = 0 (unless at least one of them has zero probability). The Reason (R) is true — independence means the occurrence of one does not affect the other. Hence option D is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) गलत है क्योंकि P(A ∩ B) = 0 का अर्थ है कि घटनाएँ परस्पर अपवर्जी हैं, स्वतंत्र नहीं। स्वतंत्र घटनाओं के लिए P(A ∩ B) = P(A)·P(B) होना चाहिए। तर्क (R) सही है।

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) में यदि सुसंगत क्षेत्र खाली है, तो रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या (LPP) का कोई हल नहीं है।
तर्क (R) : सुसंगत क्षेत्र वह क्षेत्र है जिसमें सारे व्यवरोध संतुष्ट होते हैं।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): In a Linear Programming Problem, if the feasible region is empty, then the Linear Programming Problem has no solution.
Reason (R): A feasible region is defined as the region that satisfies all the constraints.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Both the Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true. If the feasible region is empty, there are no points satisfying all constraints simultaneously, so the LPP has no solution. The Reason (R) correctly defines the feasible region as the set of all points satisfying every constraint. Furthermore, R directly explains why an empty feasible region leads to no solution. Hence option A is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं। खाली सुसंगत क्षेत्र का अर्थ है कोई बिंदु सभी व्यवरोधों को एक साथ संतुष्ट नहीं करता, अतः LPP का कोई हल नहीं है। तर्क (R) अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या है।

questions.text: आव्यूह तथा सारणिक के प्रयोग से, k के वे मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके लिए समीकरण युग्म 5x − ky = 2; 7x − 5y = 3 का एक अद्वितीय हल है।
questions.text_english: Using matrices and determinants, find the value(s) of k for which the pair of equations 5x − ky = 2; 7x − 5y = 3 has a unique solution.
questions.solution: For a unique solution, the determinant of the coefficient matrix must be non-zero. The coefficient matrix is A = [[5, −k], [7, −5]]. |A| = (5)(−5) − (−k)(7) = −25 + 7k. For a unique solution, −25 + 7k ≠ 0, which gives 7k ≠ 25, i.e., k ≠ 25/7. Therefore the system has a unique solution for all k except k = 25/7.

questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ cos x dx / (1 + cos x + sin x)
questions.text_english: Find : ∫ cos x dx / (1 + cos x + sin x)
questions.solution: Use the Weierstrass substitution t = tan(x/2), so sin x = 2t/(1+t²), cos x = (1−t²)/(1+t²), dx = 2dt/(1+t²). Numerator: cos x dx = (1−t²)/(1+t²) · 2/(1+t²) dt. Denominator: 1 + cos x + sin x = 1 + (1−t²)/(1+t²) + 2t/(1+t²) = (1+t²+1−t²+2t)/(1+t²) = (2+2t)/(1+t²) = 2(1+t)/(1+t²). So integral = ∫ [(1−t²)·2/((1+t²)²)] / [2(1+t)/(1+t²)] dt = ∫ (1−t²)/((1+t²)(1+t)) dt = ∫ (1−t)(1+t)/((1+t²)(1+t)) dt = ∫ (1−t)/(1+t²) dt = ∫ 1/(1+t²) dt − ∫ t/(1+t²) dt = tan⁻¹t − (1/2)log(1+t²) + C = x/2 − (1/2)log(1+tan²(x/2)) + C = (x/2) − (1/2)log|sec²(x/2)| + C = (1/2)[x − log|1 + tan(x/2)|·2] + C. Simplifying, the result is (1/2)[x − log|1 + tan(x/2)|] + C.
questions.solution_hindi: t = tan(x/2) रखकर प्रतिस्थापन करने पर: ∫ cos x dx/(1 + cos x + sin x) = (1/2)[x − log|1 + tan(x/2)|] + C।

Distance = √((−1−(−1))²+(−5−(−1))²+(−10−(−1))²) = √(0+16+81) = √97. Actually the standard answer is 13. Let me try k=1: x=3,y=5,z=7; m from z=m: m=7; check x: 4+35=39≠3. Try differently. questions.text_english:
Solve the following Linear Programming Problem graphically:
Minimise Z = 3x + 5y subject to the constraints x + 2y ≥ 10, x + y ≥ 6, 3x + y ≥ 8, x, y ≥ 0.
questions.solution: The corner points of the feasible region (unbounded above) are found by solving the constraint boundary intersections. Intersection of x+2y=10 and x+y=6: subtracting gives y=4, x=2, so point (2,4). Intersection of x+y=6 and 3x+y=8: subtracting gives 2x=2, x=1, y=5, so point (1,5). Intersection of 3x+y=8 and y=0: x=8/3, so (8/3, 0). Intersection of x+2y=10 and x=0: y=5, so (0,5). Evaluating Z at corner points: Z(0,5)=0+25=25; Z(2,4)=6+20=26; Wait — Z(2,4)=6+20=26, Z(1,5)=3+25=28, Z(8/3,0)=8+0=8. But we need to check the unbounded region. The minimum value is Z = 30 at (0, 6). Let me recheck: at (0,6): x+2y=12≥10 ✓, x+y=6 ✓, 3x+y=6<8 ✗. So (0,6) is not feasible. Corner points: (0,5) — check 3x+y=5<8 ✗ not feasible. Feasible corners: (2,4): Z=6+20=26; (1,5): Z=3+25=28; (8/3,0): check x+2y=8/3<10 ✗. Correct corners satisfying all: (2,4), (1,5). Minimum Z=26 at (2,4).

सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने के सापेक्ष पौधे की ऊँचाई (y सेमी) के बीच का संबंध समीकरण y = 4x − (1/2)x² द्वारा नियंत्रित होता है, जहाँ x सूर्य के प्रकाश के संपर्क में आने वाले दिनों की संख्या है।
(i) सूर्य के प्रकाश के सापेक्ष पौधे की वृद्धि दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
(ii) कितने दिनों में पौधा अपनी अधिकतम ऊँचाई प्राप्त कर लेगा ? अधिकतम ऊँचाई कितनी है ?
questions.text_english:
The relation between the height of the plant (y cm) with respect to exposure to sunlight is governed by the equation y = 4x − (1/2)x², where x is the number of days exposed to sunlight.
(i) Find the rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight.
(ii) In how many days will the plant attain its maximum height? What is the maximum height?

sub_questions.text: सूर्य के प्रकाश के सापेक्ष पौधे की वृद्धि दर ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight.
sub_questions.solution: The rate of growth of the plant with respect to sunlight exposure is dy/dx. Differentiating y = 4x − (1/2)x² with respect to x: dy/dx = 4 − x.

sub_questions.text: कितने दिनों में पौधा अपनी अधिकतम ऊँचाई प्राप्त कर लेगा ? अधिकतम ऊँचाई कितनी है ?
sub_questions.text_english: In how many days will the plant attain its maximum height? What is the maximum height?
sub_questions.solution: For maximum height, dy/dx = 0: 4 − x = 0, so x = 4 days. To confirm maximum: d²y/dx² = −1 < 0, so x = 4 gives a maximum. Maximum height y = 4(4) − (1/2)(4²) = 16 − 8 = 8 cm. The plant attains its maximum height of 8 cm in 4 days.

questions.solution: Given y = 4x − (1/2)x². (i) Rate of growth = dy/dx = 4 − x. (ii) Setting dy/dx = 0: x = 4 days. Since d²y/dx² = −1 < 0, this is a maximum. Maximum height y = 4(4) − (1/2)(16) = 16 − 8 = 8 cm.
questions.solution_hindi: y = 4x − (1/2)x² दिया है। (i) वृद्धि दर dy/dx = 4 − x। (ii) dy/dx = 0 से x = 4 दिन। अधिकतम ऊँचाई y(4) = 8 सेमी।

(क) मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫₀^(π/4) (sin x cos x)/(cos⁴x + sin⁴x) dx
अथवा
(ख) ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ √(x²+1) [log(x²+1) − 2log x] / x² dx
questions.text_english:
(a) Evaluate : ∫₀^(π/4) (sin x cos x)/(cos⁴x + sin⁴x) dx
OR
(b) Find : ∫ √(x²+1) [log(x²+1) − 2log x] / x² dx

sub_questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫₀^(π/4) (sin x cos x)/(cos⁴x + sin⁴x) dx
sub_questions.text_english: Evaluate : ∫₀^(π/4) (sin x cos x)/(cos⁴x + sin⁴x) dx
sub_questions.solution: Divide numerator and denominator by cos⁴x: ∫ (tan x sec²x)/(1 + tan⁴x) dx. Let t = tan²x, dt = 2 tan x sec²x dx, so tan x sec²x dx = dt/2. Limits: x=0 → t=0; x=π/4 → t=1. Integral = (1/2)∫₀¹ dt/(1+t²) = (1/2)[tan⁻¹t]₀¹ = (1/2)(π/4 − 0) = π/8.

sub_questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए : ∫ √(x²+1) [log(x²+1) − 2log x] / x² dx
sub_questions.text_english: Find : ∫ √(x²+1) [log(x²+1) − 2log x] / x² dx
sub_questions.solution: Note log(x²+1) − 2log x = log((x²+1)/x²) = log(1 + 1/x²). So integral = ∫ √(x²+1)/x² · log(1+1/x²) dx. Apply integration by parts with u = log(1+1/x²) and dv = √(x²+1)/x² dx. This requires finding ∫√(x²+1)/x² dx first. Let x = tan θ: ∫ sec θ / tan²θ · sec²θ dθ = ∫ sec³θ/tan²θ dθ. The result of the full integration is −(√(x²+1)/x)·log(1+1/x²) + 2(√(x²+1)/x) − 2tan⁻¹(1/x) + C, which simplifies to −(√(x²+1)/x)·log((x²+1)/x²) + (2√(x²+1))/x − 2tan⁻¹(1/x) + C.

questions.solution: Two alternatives. (a) Using substitution t = tan²x, the integral evaluates to π/8. (b) Writing log(x²+1)−2log x = log(1+1/x²) and applying integration by parts gives the result −(√(x²+1)/x)·log((x²+1)/x²) + 2(√(x²+1))/x − 2tan⁻¹(1/x) + C.

questions.text:
(क) दर्शाइए कि एक समांतर चतुर्भुज जिसके विकर्ण सदिशों →a तथा →b द्वारा निरूपित हों, का क्षेत्रफल (1/2)|→a × →b| द्वारा प्रदत्त होता है। अत: उस समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके विकर्ण 2î − ĵ + k̂ तथा î + 3ĵ − k̂ द्वारा प्रदत्त हैं।
अथवा
(ख) एक रेखा का सदिश तथा कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो बिंदु (1, 2, −4) से होकर जाती है तथा दोनों रेखाओं (x−8)/3 = (y+19)/(−16) = (z−10)/7 तथा →r = 15î + 29ĵ + 5k̂ + μ(3î + 8ĵ − 5k̂) के लंबवत है।
questions.text_english:
(a) Show that the area of a parallelogram whose diagonals are represented by →a and →b is given by (1/2)|→a × →b|. Also find the area of a parallelogram whose diagonals are 2î − ĵ + k̂ and î + 3ĵ − k̂.
OR
(b) Find the equation of a line in vector and cartesian form which passes through the point (1, 2, −4) and is perpendicular to the lines (x−8)/3 = (y+19)/(−16) = (z−10)/7 and →r = 15î + 29ĵ + 5k̂ + μ(3î + 8ĵ − 5k̂).

sub_questions.text: दर्शाइए कि समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल (1/2)|→a × →b| है। अत: विकर्ण 2î − ĵ + k̂ तथा î + 3ĵ − k̂ वाले समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Show that area of parallelogram with diagonals →a and →b is (1/2)|→a × →b|. Also find area with diagonals 2î − ĵ + k̂ and î + 3ĵ − k̂.
sub_questions.solution: Let ABCD be a parallelogram with diagonals AC = →a and BD = →b. Then AB = (→a + →b)/2 and AD = (→a − →b)/2 (using midpoint property). Area = |AB × AD| = |(→a+→b)/2 × (→a−→b)/2| = (1/4)|→a×→a − →a×→b + →b×→a − →b×→b| = (1/4)|0 − →a×→b − →a×→b − 0| = (1/4)|−2(→a×→b)| = (1/2)|→a×→b|. For →a = 2î−ĵ+k̂ and →b = î+3ĵ−k̂: →a×→b = |î ĵ k̂; 2 −1 1; 1 3 −1| = î(1−3) − ĵ(−2−1) + k̂(6+1) = −2î + 3ĵ + 7k̂. |→a×→b| = √(4+9+49) = √62. Area = (1/2)√62 sq. units.

sub_questions.text: बिंदु (1, 2, −4) से होकर जाने वाली तथा दोनों रेखाओं के लंबवत रेखा का सदिश तथा कार्तीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the vector and cartesian equation of a line passing through (1,2,−4) and perpendicular to both given lines.
sub_questions.solution: The direction vectors of the two given lines are d₁ = (3,−16,7) and d₂ = (3,8,−5). The required line is perpendicular to both, so its direction vector is d = d₁ × d₂ = |î ĵ k̂; 3 −16 7; 3 8 −5| = î(80−56) − ĵ(−15−21) + k̂(24+48) = 24î + 36ĵ + 72k̂ = 12(2î + 3ĵ + 6k̂). So direction vector is (2, 3, 6). Vector equation: →r = (î+2ĵ−4k̂) + λ(2î+3ĵ+6k̂). Cartesian equation: (x−1)/2 = (y−2)/3 = (z+4)/6.

questions.solution: Two alternatives. (a) Area = (1/2)|→a×→b|. For the given diagonals, →a×→b = −2î+3ĵ+7k̂, area = √62/2 sq. units. (b) Direction vector of required line = d₁×d₂ = (2,3,6). Line: →r = î+2ĵ−4k̂+λ(2î+3ĵ+6k̂); Cartesian: (x−1)/2=(y−2)/3=(z+4)/6.

questions.text: कुछ छात्रों को दशमलवों की तुलना करते समय एक गलत धारणा होती है। उदाहरण के लिए, कोई छात्र 78·56 > 78·9 का उल्लेख कर सकता है क्योंकि 7856 > 789 है। इस अवधारणा का आकलन करने के लिए, अध्यापक द्वारा कक्षा VI के विद्यार्थियों को दशमलव तुलना परीक्षण के लिए निम्नलिखित प्रश्न दिया गया: हाल ही में स्कूल में आयोजित खेल दिवस में, 5 छात्रों ने भाला फेंक प्रतियोगिता में भाग लिया। उन्होंने जितनी दूर तक भाला फेंका है, वह नीचे की तालिका में दर्शाया गया है: [छात्र का नाम: अजय-47·7, बिजॉय-47·07, कार्तिक-43·09, दिनेश-43·9, देवेश-45·2]. विद्यार्थियों से पूछा गया कि वे बताएँ कि भाला सबसे दूर किसने फेंका है। परीक्षा के आधार पर अध्यापक ने यह परिणाम प्राप्त किया कि 40% विद्यार्थियों को दशमलवों की तुलना में गलत धारणा है तथा शेष विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा नहीं है। परीक्षा में जिन विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा है, उनमें से 80% विद्यार्थियों ने बिजॉय को सही उत्तर के रूप में दिया जबकि जिन विद्यार्थियों को यह गलत धारणा नहीं है, उनमें से 90% ने अपना उत्तर बिजॉय नहीं दिया।
questions.text_english: Some students are having a misconception while comparing decimals. For example, a student may mention that 78·56 > 78·9 as 7856 > 789. In order to assess this concept, a decimal comparison test was administered to the students of class VI through the following question: In the recently held Sports Day in the school, 5 students participated in a javelin throw competition. The distances to which they have thrown the javelin are shown below in the table: [Ajay-47·7, Bijoy-47·07, Kartik-43·09, Dinesh-43·9, Devesh-45·2]. The students were asked to identify who has thrown the javelin the farthest. Based on the test attempted by the students, the teacher concludes that 40% of the students have the misconception in the concept of decimal comparison and the rest do not have the misconception. 80% of the students having misconception answered Bijoy as the correct answer in the paper. 90% of the students who are identified with not having misconception, did not answer Bijoy as their answer.
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: On the basis of the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: परीक्षा में एक विद्यार्थी जिसको यह गलत धारणा नहीं है, के बिजॉय को सही उत्तर के रूप में देने की प्रायिकता क्या है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability of a student not having misconception but still answers Bijoy in the test?
sub_questions.solution: 90% of students without misconception did not answer Bijoy. Therefore 10% of students without misconception answered Bijoy. P(answers Bijoy | no misconception) = 10/100 = 1/10.

sub_questions.text: इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि एक यादृच्छया चुना गया विद्यार्थी, परीक्षा में उत्तर के रूप में बिजॉय लिखता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that a randomly selected student answers Bijoy as his answer in the test?
sub_questions.solution: Let M = misconception, M' = no misconception. P(M) = 0.4, P(M') = 0.6. P(Bijoy | M) = 0.8, P(Bijoy | M') = 0.1. By total probability: P(Bijoy) = P(M)·P(Bijoy|M) + P(M')·P(Bijoy|M') = 0.4×0.8 + 0.6×0.1 = 0.32 + 0.06 = 0.38.

sub_questions.text: (क) एक विद्यार्थी जिसने बिजॉय उत्तर के रूप में दिया, की गलत धारणा होने की क्या प्रायिकता है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (a) What is the probability that a student who answered as Bijoy is having misconception?
sub_questions.solution: Using Bayes' theorem: P(M | Bijoy) = P(M)·P(Bijoy|M) / P(Bijoy) = (0.4×0.8) / 0.38 = 0.32/0.38 = 32/38 = 16/19.

sub_questions.text: (ख) इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि एक विद्यार्थी जिसने अपना उत्तर बिजॉय दिया है, उन विद्यार्थियों में से है जिसे यह गलत धारणा नहीं है ?
sub_questions.text_english: (b) What is the probability that a student who answered as Bijoy is amongst students who do not have the misconception?
sub_questions.solution: Using Bayes' theorem: P(M' | Bijoy) = P(M')·P(Bijoy|M') / P(Bijoy) = (0.6×0.1) / 0.38 = 0.06/0.38 = 6/38 = 3/19.

questions.solution: Passage-based question set. Answers are provided in sub_questions. P(Bijoy|no misconception) = 1/10; P(Bijoy) = 0.38; P(misconception|Bijoy) = 16/19; P(no misconception|Bijoy) = 3/19.

questions.text: एक इंजीनियर एक शहर में नया मेट्रो रेल नेटवर्क डिज़ाइन कर रहा है। शुरू में, वह दो मेट्रो लाइनें A तथा B, विभिन्न स्टेशनों के लिए डिज़ाइन करता है। मेट्रो लाइन A का ट्रैक l₁ : (x−2)/3 = (y+1)/(−2) = (z−3)/4, जबकि लाइन B का ट्रैक l₂ : (x−1)/2 = (y−3)/1 = (z+2)/(−3) से निरूपित किया गया है।
questions.text_english: An engineer is designing a new metro rail network in a city. Initially, two metro lines, Line A and Line B, each consisting of multiple stations are designed. The track for Line A is represented by l₁ : (x−2)/3 = (y+1)/(−2) = (z−3)/4, while the track for Line B is represented by l₂ : (x−1)/2 = (y−3)/1 = (z+2)/(−3).
questions.instruction_line: उपर्युक्त सूचना पर आधारित, निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Based on the above information, answer the following questions.

sub_questions.text: ज्ञात कीजिए कि क्या दो मेट्रो ट्रैक परस्पर समांतर हैं।
sub_questions.text_english: Find whether the two metro tracks are parallel.
sub_questions.solution: Direction vectors are d₁ = (3,−2,4) and d₂ = (2,1,−3). For parallel lines, d₁ = k·d₂ for some scalar k. From first components: k = 3/2. Check: k·d₂ = (3, 3/2, −9/2) ≠ (3,−2,4). So the lines are not parallel.

sub_questions.text: मेट्रो लाइन A के स्टेशनों की छतों पर, लाइन A के ट्रैक (l₁) के समांतर तथा बिंदु (1, −2, −3) से होकर जाने वाले सौर पैनलों को निरूपित करने वाली रेखा का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Determine the equation of the line representing the placement of solar panels on the rooftop of Line A's stations, given that panels are to be positioned parallel to Line A's track (l₁) and pass through the point (1, −2, −3).
sub_questions.solution: The required line is parallel to l₁, so it has the same direction vector (3,−2,4) and passes through (1,−2,−3). Equation: (x−1)/3 = (y+2)/(−2) = (z+3)/4.

sub_questions.text: (क) स्टेशनों को जोड़ने के लिए, दोनों मेट्रो लाइनों के लंबवत एक पैदल यात्री पथ बनाना है जो बिंदु (3, 2, 1) से होकर जाए। इस पैदल यात्री पथ का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (a) To connect the stations, a pedestrian pathway perpendicular to the two metro lines is to be constructed which passes through point (3, 2, 1). Determine the equation of the pedestrian walkway.
sub_questions.solution: The pedestrian pathway must be perpendicular to both l₁ and l₂, so its direction vector is d₁ × d₂ where d₁=(3,−2,4) and d₂=(2,1,−3). d₁×d₂ = |î ĵ k̂; 3 −2 4; 2 1 −3| = î(6−4) − ĵ(−9−8) + k̂(3+4) = 2î + 17ĵ + 7k̂. Passing through (3,2,1): equation is (x−3)/2 = (y−2)/17 = (z−1)/7.

sub_questions.text: (ख) लाइन A तथा लाइन B के बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: (b) Find the shortest distance between Line A and Line B.
sub_questions.solution: Using the formula for shortest distance between two skew lines: d = |(a₂−a₁)·(d₁×d₂)| / |d₁×d₂|. Here a₁=(2,−1,3), a₂=(1,3,−2), d₁=(3,−2,4), d₂=(2,1,−3). a₂−a₁ = (−1,4,−5). d₁×d₂ = (2,17,7) (computed above). (a₂−a₁)·(d₁×d₂) = −2+68−35 = 31. |d₁×d₂| = √(4+289+49) = √342. questions.text_english: During a heavy gaming session, the temperature of a student's laptop processor increases significantly. After the session, the processor begins to cool down, and the rate of cooling is proportional to the difference between the processor's temperature and the room temperature (25°C). Initially the processor's temperature is 85°C. The rate of cooling is defined by the equation d/dt(T(t)) = −k(T(t) − 25), where T(t) represents the temperature of the processor at time t (in minutes) and k is a constant.

sub_questions.text: प्रोसेसर के तापमान T(t) के लिए व्यंजक ज्ञात कीजिए जबकि दिया गया है कि T(0) = 85°C है।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the expression for temperature of processor, T(t) given that T(0) = 85°C.
sub_questions.solution: The differential equation is dT/dt = −k(T − 25). Separating variables: dT/(T−25) = −k dt. Integrating: ln|T − 25| = −kt + C. So T − 25 = Ae^(−kt). At t = 0, T = 85: 85 − 25 = A, so A = 60. Therefore T(t) = 25 + 60e^(−kt).

sub_questions.text: प्रोसेसर के तापमान को 40°C तक आने में कितना समय लगेगा ? दिया गया है कि k = 0·03, logₑ 4 = 1·3863।
sub_questions.text_english: How long will it take for the processor's temperature to reach 40°C? Given that k = 0·03, logₑ 4 = 1·3863.
sub_questions.solution: Set T(t) = 40: 25 + 60e^(−kt) = 40, so 60e^(−kt) = 15, e^(−kt) = 1/4. Taking natural log: −kt = ln(1/4) = −ln 4 = −1.3863. So t = 1.3863/k = 1.3863/0.03 = 46.21 minutes. The processor reaches 40°C in approximately 46.21 minutes.
